tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Return the full catalog: 15 products (id, name, price, bulk discount text, category, image, description, cj_vid) and 4 bundles, plus payment methods and free-shipping threshold.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Fuzzy/semantic product search over the catalog. Returns ranked matches with prices and any bundles that contain a match.

tools.name: suggest_bundle
tools.description: Given the item ids a buyer wants and an optional budget, return the fixed bundles plus custom cross-subsidised combinations. Each custom entry gives retail, bundle price, savings and a per-line allocation so a multi-party split stays fair.

tools.name: negotiate_price
tools.description: Propose a target total for a set of items. The server replies with the lowest price it can legally accept; the floor is supplier cost + 12% margin, and matching bundles override per-item pricing.

tools.name: validate_split
tools.description: Check that a proposed multi-recipient allocation sums exactly to the order total. Returns allocOk plus the discrepancy. Use before create_checkout when several agents share the cost.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create an order and receive a PayPal payment URL (cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Venmo). Nothing is charged here: the URL must be approved by whoever holds the funds. On payment capture the order is forwarded automatically to CJ Dropshipping with USPS last-mile.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_checkout · Public sink: validate_split.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_checkout · Public sink: validate_split

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
